name: AppWindow (ui/app.slint) + build_window / draft_notice

test_list.description: The Send and Attach buttons report accessible-enabled false and their labels say they are unavailable until the kernel bridge (P9) is connected; send-enabled is false.
Activating the pill opens the menu; activating a model row, the 'auto' segment and the 'max' segment sets model-index 1, mode-index 1 and effort-index 4.
Editing the draft calls draft-edited; a normal draft leaves draft-notice empty, an over-budget draft (beyond composer MAX_TEXT_BYTES) sets a notice.
Activating 'New conversation' empties the draft and the notice and closes the menu.
Activating 'Session context' flips context-open both ways.
Activating 'About Polaris' opens the About panel, which contains the AboutSlint widget (licence ADR-014).
Sidebar entries for pages the desktop shell lacks carry a tooltip saying they are not in the desktop shell yet.
The window renders through Slint's software renderer into a pixel buffer; the buffer is not uniformly one colour (text and composer are drawn).

inputs.name: options
inputs.description: Version, workspace path and reduced-motion flag.

output_description: A configured window whose controls behave as listed.
